descriptions.d24l_text_list_lines_8029f598: Replaces a text list's lines: releases the old entries, clears +268, then walks a String copy of the text: each newline-terminated part is copied, cut at the newline (0x8020c3a0) with the remainder moved through 0x8020c0fc, and added via 0x8029f714(self, line, a, b); the final part is added whole and the remainder becomes the shared empty string 0x804b06a0.
